name: Elara
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the radius JPL Horizons lists; these are not three measured axes.

shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 40 km radius JPL Horizons lists for Elara. No shape model is published.

introduction: Elara is an outer, irregular moon of Jupiter, discovered in 1905. It follows a wide, tilted orbit far beyond the large moons.
card: An outer, irregular moon of Jupiter.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 40 km radius JPL lists. Its shape, pole and rotation are not measured.
